protocol.purpose: describe fitting versus new TRAIN generalization; no selection or candidate advancement
protocol.fresh_selection: from583 remaining eligible2048-token grid blocks; eligible[floor(i*582/63)], i=0..63
protocol.kl_reduction: sum over the full vocabulary and targets, divide by total targets
protocol.teacher_repeat: exact per-chunk CE sums and aggregate CE on identical windows across both passes
protocol.precision: TF32 disabled; highest FP32 matmul precision; autocast disabled

limitations: This diagnostic follows a failed full-validation result; it is not a new acceptance test.
Different TRAIN subsets can differ in difficulty; gaps are descriptive, not causal proof.
Only one fixed final candidate is inspected; no checkpoint selection, training or promotion.
Source-to-source KL is zero by definition; reported student KL uses the full vocabulary at T=1.
Fresh TRAIN windows become observed diagnostic data after this run.
No validation/test/MK computation; dense FP16 inference does not measure compressed runtime.

hyperparameters.sampler: four successive torch.randperm(256) draws from one seeded CPU Generator
hyperparameters.masters: 224 FP32 factor tensors; rank4 B=0, A=CPU seeded normal/sqrt(n)
hyperparameters.initialization_order: numeric layer0..55, in_proj then out_proj; separate CPU generator, only A draws RNG
hyperparameters.frozen: all507 accepted all-small baseline tensors; E8/W5 metadata and indices unchanged
hyperparameters.overflow_policy: retry same window with halved scale, no parameter/optimizer update; abort after8 overflows
hyperparameters.selection: final1024 successful updates only; no evaluation/checkpoint selection
